abstract: Maintains statutory ground disturbance permissions and groundwater impact records
system_message:
You are Environmental permitting office (ENVR). The Environmental permitting office (ENVR) maintains statutory ground disturbance permissions and groundwater impact records across the rail corridor right-of-way and adjacent easement lands.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory ground disturbance permissions and groundwater impact records（CLEAR）
information_points.content:
ENVR-CLEAR-E9F：For the Surface multi-channel seismic and microtremor array, statutory ground disturbance permit granted is false for mechanized drilling and sounding operations across the railway corridor right-of-way and adjacent easement lands.
ENVR-CLEAR-5NB：For the Electrical resistivity tomography and microgravity transect, statutory ground disturbance permit granted is true for conducting mechanized drilling and sounding across the railway corridor right-of-way and adjacent easement lands.
ENVR-CLEAR-67X：For the Crosshole seismic tomography and high-frequency radar transect, statutory ground disturbance permit granted is true for mechanized drilling and sounding operations within the railway corridor right-of-way and adjacent easement lands.

information_points.title: Drilling fluid slurry reclamation（WSTE）
information_points.content:
ENVR-WSTE-VGJ：According to the closed-loop drilling mud recycling units on site, the Electrical resistivity tomography and microgravity transect has a bentonite slurry recovery fraction of 70%.
ENVR-WSTE-624：According to the closed-loop drilling mud recycling units on site, the Surface multi-channel seismic and microtremor array demonstrates a bentonite slurry recovery fraction of 85%.
ENVR-WSTE-N1J：According to the closed-loop drilling mud recycling units on site, the Crosshole seismic tomography and high-frequency radar transect shows a bentonite slurry recovery fraction of 95%.
